acousticPublication.scope: Acoustic semantics only; reference runtime downstream finalizer is explicitly excluded from default. No production wiring.
acousticPublication.semantics: One session per execution, sequential windows, all-pitch decoder A, half-open ownership, stable observation ID, immutable performanceTimeMs and confidence; availabilityTimeMs uses actual acoustic publication on performance-origin clock; analyzed-through frontier is preceding float64 of ownedEnd. No score, labels, final verdicts or expected pitch in acoustic execution.

decoder.semantics: Contiguous >=onset threshold region; first maximum peak; reject peak if frame support <threshold; confidence=min(onset,frame); piano MIDI21..108; sort by time,pitch,stable ID.

ownership.input: inputEnd=ownedEnd+170ms; inputStart=inputEnd-1820ms; exactly29120 real samples; final partial ownership shifts full input without padding.
ownership.plannerFunction: planXc2Windows; selected parameters ownedMs=600,futureMs=170; historical common clip guard remains historical, not a new live startup specification.

resampler.algorithm: Frozen SciPy 1.14.1 firwin(8821,1/441,kaiser beta=5); float32 coefficients multiplied by160; float32 products/accumulation.
resampler.boundary: Preserve state across chunks. Zero only at stream origin or explicit finish; padded finish cannot qualify real-context owned observations.
resampler.timeMapping: Output m represents source m*441/160; wait for real source floor((m*441+4410)/160). No fitted shift or gain normalization.
